mapper.select: INSERT INTO agent_execution_session_sequence (session_id, next_sequence) VALUES (CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid), 1) ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET next_sequence = agent_execution_session_sequence.next_sequence + 1 RETURNING next_sequence - 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_execution_turn_message (chat_message_id, session_id, sequence_no) VALUES (CAST(#{messageId} AS uuid), CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid), #{sequenceNo})

INSERT INTO chat_message ( session_id, role, content, metadata, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid), #{role}, #{content}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, role, content, metadata::text AS metadata, created_at, updated_at FROM chat_message WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)

SELECT message.id, message.session_id, message.role, message.content, message.metadata::text AS metadata, message.created_at, message.updated_at FROM chat_message message LEFT JOIN agent_execution_turn_message turn ON turn.chat_message_id = message.id WHERE message.session_id = CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid) ORDER BY turn.sequence_no ASC NULLS FIRST, message.created_at ASC, message.id ASC

SELECT recent.id, recent.session_id, recent.role, recent.content, recent.metadata::text AS metadata, recent.created_at, recent.updated_at FROM ( SELECT message.id, message.session_id, message.role, message.content, message.metadata, turn.sequence_no AS agent_turn_sequence, message.created_at, message.updated_at FROM chat_message message LEFT JOIN agent_execution_turn_message turn ON turn.chat_message_id = message.id WHERE message.session_id = CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid) ORDER BY turn.sequence_no DESC NULLS LAST, message.created_at DESC, message.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent ORDER BY recent.agent_turn_sequence ASC NULLS FIRST, recent.created_at ASC, recent.id ASC

SELECT recent.id, recent.session_id, recent.role, recent.content, recent.metadata::text AS metadata, recent.created_at, recent.updated_at FROM ( SELECT message.id, message.session_id, message.role, message.content, message.metadata, turn.sequence_no AS agent_turn_sequence, message.created_at, message.updated_at FROM chat_message message LEFT JOIN agent_execution_turn_message turn ON turn.chat_message_id = message.id WHERE message.session_id = CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid) AND ( turn.sequence_no IS NULL OR turn.sequence_no <= ( SELECT target_turn.sequence_no FROM chat_message target_message LEFT JOIN agent_execution_turn_message target_turn ON target_turn.chat_message_id = target_message.id WHERE target_message.id = CAST(#{messageId} AS uuid) AND target_message.session_id = CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid) AND target_message.role = 'user' ) ) ORDER BY turn.sequence_no DESC NULLS LAST, message.created_at DESC, message.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent ORDER BY recent.agent_turn_sequence ASC NULLS FIRST, recent.created_at ASC, recent.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid) AND role = 'user'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_message WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.update:
UPDATE chat_message
session_id = CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid),
role = #{role},
content = #{content},
metadata = CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb),
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
